## About
King's Auto Parts & Service sits on E McNichols Rd in Highland Park. We carry used and aftermarket parts for all makes and models, and we've been doing it a long time.
Customers know the crew by name. One reviewer says go see Donnie, another says Sam helped them find the accurate part, and another bought a car from Joe. We're rated 4.4 from 168 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used and aftermarket parts: Used and aftermarket parts, on hand when you need them.
- Tires: One customer was glad to find we even had tires.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you carry parts for?
A: We carry all makes and models 2000 and newer.

Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. Parts come with a 30 day standard warranty.
